prompt: Music fans are thrilled because an extra concert date (to add) to the summer tour.
explanation_ru: Фанаты рады сейчас, так как новая дата уже добавлена к туру — результат к настоящему моменту требует Present Perfect Passive: has been added.

prompt: Our street is quiet today. The old road signs (to take) down. New lights (to put) up next week.
explanation_ru: Знаки уже сняли раньше (were taken), а слова next week указывают на будущее действие: will be put.

prompt: All these soft wool hats ___ by hand in a small village.
explanation_ru: Hats — множественное число, а третья форма от make — made: are made, а не are make.

prompt: All fitness mats (to wash) after the last evening class.
explanation_ru: Речь о регулярной уборке в зале, поэтому используется Present Simple Passive: are washed.

prompt: The kitchen window was shut, so the loud noise (not / to hear).
explanation_ru: Первая часть в прошлом (was shut), поэтому отрицание строится в Past Simple Passive: was not heard.

prompt: My office report was not send before five o'clock.
answer: My office report was not sent before five o'clock.
accepted_answers: My office report was not sent before five o'clock.
My office report wasn't sent before five o'clock.
explanation_ru: В пассиве после was нужна третья форма неправильного глагола send: sent, а не send.

prompt: The main reading room is closed right now. Old wooden shelves (to replace) with modern metal ones. So far, over two thousand books (to move) to the second floor. The room will reopen on Monday.
explanation_ru: Right now указывает на процесс в настоящем (are being replaced), а so far — на результат к текущему моменту: have been moved.

prompt: Have you (to inform) about the new bus lane in the town centre?
explanation_ru: В вопросе Present Perfect Passive после Have и подлежащего ставится been + V3: been informed.

prompt: First-year pupils (to give) free art books at this school.
explanation_ru: Это постоянное школьное правило, поэтому нужен Present Simple Passive: are given.

prompt: Please take a seat; your fresh coffee (to prepare) at the counter right now.
explanation_ru: Кофе готовят прямо сейчас (right now), поэтому нужен Present Continuous Passive: is being prepared.

prompt: When you knocked on the door, your hotel room (to clean) by the staff.
explanation_ru: Действие было в процессе в конкретный момент в прошлом (When you knocked), поэтому нужен Past Continuous Passive: was being cleaned.

prompt: Strong winds are coming, and small boats (to keep) in port.
explanation_ru: Речь о мере, которую примут в ближайшем будущем из-за надвигающегося ветра: will be kept.

prompt: A big tree fell in the park last night. Two lamps (to break). The path (to clear) this afternoon.
explanation_ru: Last night указывает на Past Simple Passive (were broken), а план на вторую половину дня — на Future Simple Passive (will be cleared).

prompt: We buy milk at the corner food shop. Cold drinks (to keep) at the back. Tomorrow, fresh berries (to bring) from the farm.
explanation_ru: Напитки хранятся там постоянно (are kept), а tomorrow переводит поставку ягод в будущее: will be brought.

prompt: Sign this form, and you (to call) when your card arrives.
explanation_ru: После повелительного наклонения (Sign) обещание на будущее выражается через Future Simple Passive: will be called.

prompt: Don't worry about your blue scarf! It (to find) on the station bench an hour ago. Your name (to write) in our lost-property book already. You can pick it up at the desk.
explanation_ru: An hour ago требует Past Simple Passive (was found), а слово already — Present Perfect Passive (has been written).

prompt: Mind the wet walls: the hallway (to paint) bright yellow today.
explanation_ru: Предупреждение Mind the wet walls показывает, что покраска идёт сейчас: is being painted.

prompt: Old mobile apps (not / to support) on this new phone.
explanation_ru: Описывается постоянное свойство телефона, поэтому используется Present Simple Passive: are not supported.

prompt: I am so excited because I (to offer) the design job at last!
explanation_ru: Радость в настоящем связана с только что полученным предложением (at last), поэтому нужен Present Perfect Passive: have been offered.

prompt: While the final match (to play) in the rain, fans cheered loudly.
explanation_ru: Союз while вводит длительный процесс в прошлом, поэтому нужен Past Continuous Passive: was being played.

prompt: In this salad, green beans (to boil) for five minutes.
explanation_ru: Рецепт описывает стандартный шаг приготовления, поэтому используется Present Simple Passive: are boiled.

prompt: Faster evening trains (to add) to this line in June.
explanation_ru: Речь о запланированном изменении расписания в будущем: will be added.

prompt: Moving day was very busy. While the heavy cupboards (to carry) up the stairs, it started to rain. Luckily, all the fragile plates (to pack) safely before that. Nothing broke during the move.
explanation_ru: While вводит длительное действие в прошлом (were being carried), а завершённое событие в рассказе о прошлом передаётся через Past Simple Passive (were packed).

prompt: Sorry for the noise, our kitchen roof ___ at the moment.
explanation_ru: Крышу чинят сейчас (at the moment) — нужен Present Continuous Passive: is being repaired, а не активное is repairing.

prompt: Was my email (to read) by the team manager yesterday?
explanation_ru: В вопросе Past Simple Passive после Was и подлежащего ставится третья форма глагола: read.

prompt: We arrived at the theatre early. Our coats (to take) at the cloakroom right away. Now, the stage lights (to test) behind the red curtain. The play starts in ten minutes.
explanation_ru: Пальто приняли в прошлом (arrived → were taken), а слово now указывает на текущий процесс: are being tested.

prompt: Bad news for passengers: the evening flight to Rome ___ because of fog.
explanation_ru: Рейс в единственном числе, и нужна третья форма глагола (V3): has been delayed, а не has been delay или have been delayed.

prompt: Our museum trip did not go smoothly. While we (to show) around the old hall, the fire alarm rang. Everyone had to leave, and our bags (to leave) inside for twenty minutes.
explanation_ru: While вводит длительное действие в прошлом (were being shown), а последовавшее событие передаётся через Past Simple Passive (were left).

prompt: I checked the tracking page, and my parcel (not / to deliver) yet.
explanation_ru: Слово yet в отрицании указывает на отсутствие результата к настоящему моменту — Present Perfect Passive: has not been delivered.

prompt: Our holiday was great, and we (to welcome) with flowers.
explanation_ru: Рассказ идёт о прошедшем отпуске (was great), поэтому используется Past Simple Passive: were welcomed.

prompt: This online store works very fast. Every order (to check) twice before it leaves the warehouse. Right now, dozens of winter jackets (to pack) for morning delivery. Customers usually get a tracking link within an hour.
explanation_ru: Постоянное правило магазина передаётся через Present Simple Passive (is checked), а процесс в данный момент (right now) — через Present Continuous Passive (are being packed).

prompt: Mark was upset because his lecture notes (not / to record) during the talk.
explanation_ru: Речь о процессе, который не шёл во время лекции в прошлом (during the talk), поэтому нужен Past Continuous Passive: were not being recorded.

prompt: Good news at the local clinic! A new waiting area (to open) for parents and young children. Also, all test results (to send) by text message from next week. Patients will save a lot of time.
explanation_ru: Новость о только что открывшейся зоне требует Present Perfect Passive (has been opened), а from next week — Future Simple Passive (will be sent).

prompt: Ruby's garden looks lovely. The tall grass (to cut) yesterday. Her sweet apples (to share) with friends every autumn.
explanation_ru: Yesterday требует Past Simple Passive (was cut), а every autumn — Present Simple Passive (are shared).

prompt: Have we (to include) in the friendly tennis tournament this weekend?
explanation_ru: В вопросе Present Perfect Passive после Have и подлежащего ставится been + V3: been included.

prompt: Hi Liam! My old guitar (to sell) this morning. Next Friday, a new one (to deliver) to my house.
explanation_ru: Гитару уже продали утром (was sold), а next Friday указывает на будущее действие: will be delivered.

prompt: Chloe's party had a funny problem. While the birthday cake (to carry) into the garden, the dog jumped up. Half of the cream (to ruin) already, so everyone laughed and ate ice cream instead.
explanation_ru: While вводит длительное действие в прошлом (was being carried), а результат в рамках прошедшей истории передаётся через Past Simple Passive (was ruined).

prompt: Guests are complaining because hot soup (not / to serve) at the moment.
explanation_ru: Слова at the moment указывают на ситуацию прямо сейчас, поэтому нужен Present Continuous Passive: is not being served.

prompt: The main festival stage is building right now by ten workers.
answer: The main festival stage is being built right now by ten workers.
accepted_answers: The main festival stage is being built right now by ten workers.
explanation_ru: Сцена не строит сама себя — её строят сейчас. Нужен Present Continuous Passive: is being built, а не is building.

prompt: I crossed on red, and I (to stop) by an officer.
explanation_ru: Первая часть в прошлом (crossed), поэтому и второе действие в Past Simple Passive: was stopped.

prompt: Are winter coats (to keep) on the top floor here?
explanation_ru: В вопросе Present Simple Passive после Are и подлежащего ставится третья форма глагола: kept.

prompt: New running shoes (to give) to the winners after the race.
explanation_ru: Речь о награждении после забега в будущем, поэтому нужен Future Simple Passive: will be given.
